resources.string: After you launch Casualty, the shared shortcut cleanup helper force-stops official Shield iPlayer and verifies its processes are gone before starting your programme. Approve the on-device debugging prompt once; the private key stays on the Shield. This helper selects the existing profile and newest episode, skips one exact Skip trailer control if offered, and fully stops iPlayer when playback returns to the programme page before going Home. Pause stays in the player. Other-app foreground changes cancel the macro. It does not clear iPlayer data or settings, record screens, or send data off this device.
